questions.question: What are three (3) examples of the form that a ‘business and corporate’ event might take?
guidance: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
Promotional events to draw attention to the company and what it does or has to offer
Various forms of meetings – such as all-of-staff meetings, shareholder meetings or Annual General Meetings (AGMs)
A team-building activity – for designated departments or individuals
An incentive program – where staff are rewarded for effort or achieving a given workplace performance target.
answer_instructions: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
answer_points: Promotional events to draw attention to the company and what it does or has to offer
Various forms of meetings – such as all-of-staff meetings, shareholder meetings or Annual General Meetings (AGMs)
A team-building activity – for designated departments or individuals
An incentive program – where staff are rewarded for effort or achieving a given workplace performance target.

questions.question: What are three (3) examples of operational and venue requirements that may apply to business and corporate events, government and civic events and meeting and convention events?
guidance: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
Auditorium for welcome address and daily meetings and updates
Break-out rooms and a variety of meeting rooms of different sizes
Audio-video facilities for the presentation, recording and transmission of speeches etc
Fitness and relaxation facilities – spa and wellness centres, gymnasium
A variety of on-site entertainment options

Break-out rooms and a variety of meeting rooms of different sizes
Audio-video facilities for the presentation, recording and transmission of speeches etc
Fitness and relaxation facilities – spa and wellness centres, gymnasium

questions.question: What are three (3) examples of operational and venue requirements that may apply to exhibition, exposition and fair events?
guidance: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
Areas, spaces and rooms for stands and stalls to be hired out to holders
On-site catering/kitchens or room for same to occur on-site
Public address capability with capacity for playing background music
Ability for stands and stalls to  connect to power, gas, water in and water out
answer_instructions: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
answer_points: Areas, spaces and rooms for stands and stalls to be hired out to holders
On-site catering/kitchens or room for same to occur on-site
Public address capability with capacity for playing background music
Ability for stands and stalls to  connect to power, gas, water in and water out

questions.question: What are three (3) examples of operational and venue requirements that may apply to festival events?
guidance: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
Fencing – to define the event area and assist with security and crowd control
Sufficient and appropriate toilet facilities – based on calculations involving gender mix, duration of the event, expected numbers and whether or not alcohol is being served
Lost and found facility – and lost children area
On-site catering – which may be mobile kitchens, contractors or concession stand holders
Stages and sites for stalls, booths, displays and stands
Public address capability with capacity for playing background music
Ability to connect to power, gas and/or water or the capacity to bring same on-site
answer_instructions: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
answer_points: Fencing – to define the event area and assist with security and crowd control
Sufficient and appropriate toilet facilities – based on calculations involving gender mix, duration of the event, expected numbers and whether or not alcohol is being served
Lost and found facility – and lost children area
On-site catering – which may be mobile kitchens, contractors or concession stand holders
Stages and sites for stalls, booths, displays and stands
Public address capability with capacity for playing background music
Ability to connect to power, gas and/or water or the capacity to bring same on-site

questions.question: What are three (3) examples of operational and venue requirements that may apply to fundraising events?
guidance: Answer may address, but is not limited to, three of the following:
Facilities to support and enable the fundraising activities to be held – such as but not limited to  sporting events, telethons, music events
Audio-video facilities for the presentation, recording and transmission of the activities etc to sponsors, the public or target market donors
Support facilities (green rooms, change rooms, security etc) for celebrities and performers.

Concession stands for food and beverages
Sophisticated audio-visual and sound and lighting infrastructure – especially for broadcasting
Security control room with CCTV facilities.

questions.question: What are three (3) standard processes that may be applied to undertake a virtual inspection of a venue or site?
guidance: Access the website of the venue or site and click on the photographs provided to view the venue or site
Click on a YouTube video of the venue or site
Access the website of the venue or site and take a 3D virtual or augmented reality tour.

Click on a YouTube video of the venue or site
Access the website of the venue or site and take a 3D virtual or augmented reality tour.
